Name: Accessory Box
Author: bluebellfairy01
Description: Adds a small furniture item called "Accessory Box" to the carpenter's shop. After placing it down, you can right click on it to remove your accessory (the one chosen during character creation) and put it in the box. Click on it again to put the accessory back on.

Manifest.Name: AccessoryBox
Manifest.Description: Placeable item that toggles your accessory on/off.
Manifest.Author: bluebellfairy
